$comment: type:"dynamic" — the real site is hosted on Wix's own infrastructure (free plan, mrserebano.wixsite.com/wren-and-oat), not rendered by our nginx like the 'static' demos, and not a self-hosted CMS container like ghost/woo/wordpress. This backend is ONLY the MCP+identity server (sites/_shared/backend/mcp-identity-server.mjs) plus the six-layer agent-ready files, served here because Wix's free plan cannot host a custom static file at a path it doesn't already own. FIVE free-plan embed paths were tried and independently confirmed blocked (HTML Embed iframe never lazy-loads; Velo page code has no document/window; Custom Element is explicitly Premium-gated; the native App Market app installs only on a NEW throwaway dev site, never an existing one; the Custom Element's own un-sandboxed script is the right fix but moot while (3) gates it) — see sites/wix/README.md 'Integration' for the exact repro of each. `tenant_id`/`connector_id`/`identity_provider_id` are real rows (provisioned + live-probed via the owner MCP runner); `publish_tenant_runtime` is blocked by busymate-devtools#3026 (a platform Console bug, now with the platform-bugs lane), tracked separately from this demo. status stays "beta" until either blocker clears and a real visitor's chat answers grounded. See sites/wix/README.md.

container.note: No app/db services (unlike ghost/woo/wordpress) — the CMS is Wix's own hosting, not ours. The vhost only needs to proxy /mcp, /api/identity/*, /llms.txt, /AGENTS.md, /sitemap.md, /index.md, /agents.json, /.well-known/agents.json, /structured-data.json to the backend container.
